messages:
dani (People Ops): following up from todays all-hands Q&A  dropping a short thread for leftover questions about calibration, off-cycle promos, equity timing, and international payroll. calibration window still closes Friday 11:59pm PT. office hours Thurs 3-4pm PT.

omar (SWE): quick q: if someone was out on leave during the review window, how do managers account for impact?

rachel (Eng Manager): same one from my manager sync  we had a case where an IC was on parental leave for 6 weeks and still drove a major cross-team deliverable. want to make sure evidence is accepted.

dani (People Ops): good callouts. managers should document sustained impact pre/post-leave and include collaborator attestations. use the Leave-adjusted Evidence checkbox on the Leveling Review form. we accept cross-month evidence if it shows sustained scope.

natalie (Total Rewards): equity timing note: RSU cycle unchanged. for promos approved post-window, request a mid-cycle grant via the Grants form and mark "promo mid-cycle"; leads to review in 2 weeks.

omar (SWE): payroll question  overseas retro pay still slow  any improvements?

payroll-bot: FYI: international retro processing depends on local tax docs. standard target = 2 pay cycles; EMEA/APAC may require 3 if tax reconciliation needed. submit ticket ASAP to avoid delays.

rachel (Eng Manager): off-cycle promo process: if we need retention move + comp bump, do we submit both Off-cycle Promo + Comp Exception?

dani (People Ops): yes for combined actions submit both forms and link them in the People Ops ticket. mark the promo request as "Retention" and attach manager-up approval. People Ops triages within 3 business days; comp exceptions need Finance sign-off.

lee (Head of People): appeals reminder: appeals accepted within 10 business days of the final calibration email. manager + IC should submit the Appeal form with any new evidence; panel includes People + two neutral managers. outcomes: uphold/adjust/escalate.

omar (SWE): thanks  last one: is there a public list of what counts as "sustained scope" vs a single project?

dani (People Ops): short guidance: sustained = responsibility for an area or capability for 6+ months, repeated cross-team impact, or ongoing ownership of a service/product area. single-project wins are great but typically support a case rather than justify a band jump alone. see the Leveling Evidence checklist link in the People Portal.

lee (Head of People): action items: Dani to publish calibration FAQ and evidence checklist by EOD Wed; Natalie to publish mid-cycle grant timeline; Payroll to update international cutoff notes.

dani (People Ops): thanks all  closing thread for now. DM or open a People Ops ticket if you need 1:1 help. Reminder: calibration survey closes Friday 23:59 PT :bell:
